name: LunOS Official App Repository
purpose: Distribute and catalog LNPK application packages for the LunOS App Store.
publisherServicePurpose: Server-side developer authentication and package publishing to this repository.
securityNotes: No personal GitHub token is stored in this repository.

description: Official LunOS App Store package repository and its server-side publishing infrastructure.
